title: The Eagle Ray Experience
subtitle: A higher standard of ocean adventures
supportingLine: A crew chosen for how they sail and how they host. An expedition built around your group, not around a boat's schedule. Meals cooked on board. The Sea of Cortez at the pace your people choose.

cards.title: Passionate Sea People
cards.text:
"People who live the ocean and know how to share it."
Our crew and hosts bring real sea experience and a service mindset, and they read a group as well as they read the weather.
cards.imageAlt: Passionate Sea People Eagle Ray Expeditions
cards.imageNote: Passionate Sea People Eagle Ray Expeditions

cards.title: Standards & Quality System
cards.text: Rigorous standards, clear processes, continuous improvement and safety at the center of every expedition.

cards.title: Hospitality
cards.text: Warm, attentive: you feel looked after without being managed.

cards.title: Food & Beverage
cards.text: Fresh food, cooked on board by your chef.

cards.title: Ocean Activities
cards.text: Snorkeling and fishing on every expedition. Freediving and scuba diving with a certified specialist, when you add them. Whatever your level, a guide gets you into the water.

cards.title: Expedition Design
cards.text: Each expedition has its own rhythm and story: adventure and discovery, adapted to nature and to the group.

cards.title: Guest Journey & Concierge
cards.text: Simple and personal from booking until you get home, with a relationship that continues after the trip.

cards.title: The boats
cards.label: Our fleet
cards.text: Catamarans and monohulls, each one chosen against our safety, comfort and functionality standards.

seo.title: The Eagle Ray Experience | Eagle Ray Expeditions
seo.description: Private sailing expeditions in La Paz, Baja California Sur. What sits behind each one: the crew, the chef on board and how every day is planned with your group.
